requirements.title: The graphical display manager must not be the default target on RHEL 9 unless approved.

descriptions.label: default
descriptions.data: Unnecessary service packages must not be installed to decrease the attack surface of the system. Graphical display managers have a long history of security vulnerabilities and must not be used, unless approved and documented.

descriptions.label: check
descriptions.data:
Verify that RHEL 9 is configured to boot to the command line:

$ systemctl get-default

multi-user.target

If the system default target is not set to "multi-user.target" and the information system security officer (ISSO) lacks a documented requirement for a graphical user interface, this is a finding.

descriptions.label: fix
descriptions.data:
Document the requirement for a graphical user interface with the ISSO or set the default target to multi-user with the following command:

$ sudo systemctl set-default multi-user.target

results.message:
expected: multi-user.target
     got: graphical.target

(compared using `cmp` matcher)

requirements.code:
control 'SV-257781' do
  title 'The graphical display manager must not be the default target on RHEL 9 unless approved.'
  desc 'Unnecessary service packages must not be installed to decrease the attack surface of the system. Graphical display managers have a long history of security vulnerabilities and must not be used, unless approved and documented.'
  desc 'check', 'Verify that RHEL 9 is configured to boot to the command line:

$ systemctl get-default

multi-user.target

If the system default target is not set to "multi-user.target" and the information system security officer (ISSO) lacks a documented requirement for a graphical user interface, this is a finding.'
  desc 'fix', 'Document the requirement for a graphical user interface with the ISSO or set the default target to multi-user with the following command:

$ sudo systemctl set-default multi-user.target'
  impact 0.5
  tag check_id: 'C-61522r925328_chk'
  tag severity: 'medium'
  tag gid: 'V-257781'
  tag rid: 'SV-257781r991589_rule'
  tag stig_id: 'RHEL-09-211030'
  tag gtitle: 'SRG-OS-000480-GPOS-00227'
  tag fix_id: 'F-61446r925329_fix'
  tag 'documentable'
  tag cci: ['CCI-000366']
  tag nist: ['CM-6 b']
  tag 'host'

  only_if('This requirement is Not Applicable inside the container', impact: 0.0) {
    !virtualization.system.eql?('docker')
  }

  if input('gui_required')
    impact 0.0
    describe 'skip' do
      skip 'A GUI is indicated as a requirement for this system. This control is Not Applicable.'
    end
  else
    get_default = command('systemctl get-default').stdout.strip

    describe get_default do
      it { should cmp 'multi-user.target' }
    end
  end
end

requirements.title: RHEL 9 debug-shell systemd service must be disabled.

descriptions.label: default
descriptions.data:
The debug-shell requires no authentication and provides root
privileges to anyone who has physical access to the machine.  While this
feature is disabled by default, masking it adds an additional layer of
assurance that it will not be enabled via a dependency in systemd.  This also
prevents attackers with physical access from trivially bypassing security on
the machine through valid troubleshooting configurations and gaining root
access when the system is rebooted.

descriptions.label: check
descriptions.data:
Verify RHEL 9 is configured to mask the debug-shell systemd service with the following command:

$ sudo systemctl status debug-shell.service

debug-shell.service
Loaded: masked (Reason: Unit debug-shell.service is masked.)
Active: inactive (dead)

If the "debug-shell.service" is loaded and not masked, this is a finding.

descriptions.label: fix
descriptions.data:
Configure RHEL 9 to mask the debug-shell systemd service with the following command:

$ sudo systemctl disable --now debug-shell.service
$ sudo systemctl mask --now debug-shell.service

results.codeDesc: Service debug-shell.service params.LoadState is expected to eq "masked"
Service debug-shell.service params.LoadState is expected to eq "not-found"

requirements.code:
control 'SV-257786' do
  title 'RHEL 9 debug-shell systemd service must be disabled.'
  desc 'The debug-shell requires no authentication and provides root
privileges to anyone who has physical access to the machine.  While this
feature is disabled by default, masking it adds an additional layer of
assurance that it will not be enabled via a dependency in systemd.  This also
prevents attackers with physical access from trivially bypassing security on
the machine through valid troubleshooting configurations and gaining root
access when the system is rebooted.'
  desc 'check', 'Verify RHEL 9 is configured to mask the debug-shell systemd service with the following command:

$ sudo systemctl status debug-shell.service

debug-shell.service
Loaded: masked (Reason: Unit debug-shell.service is masked.)
Active: inactive (dead)

If the "debug-shell.service" is loaded and not masked, this is a finding.'
  desc 'fix', 'Configure RHEL 9 to mask the debug-shell systemd service with the following command:

$ sudo systemctl disable --now debug-shell.service
$ sudo systemctl mask --now debug-shell.service'
  impact 0.5
  tag severity: 'medium'
  tag gtitle: 'SRG-OS-000324-GPOS-00125'
  tag gid: 'V-257786'
  tag rid: 'SV-257786r1044834_rule'
  tag stig_id: 'RHEL-09-211055'
  tag fix_id: 'F-61451r943025_fix'
  tag cci: ['CCI-000366', 'CCI-002235']
  tag nist: ['CM-6 b', 'AC-6 (10)']
  tag 'host'

  only_if('This control is Not Applicable to containers', impact: 0.0) {
    !virtualization.system.eql?('docker')
  }

  d = systemd_service('debug-shell.service')

  describe.one do
    describe d do
      its('params.LoadState') { should eq 'masked' }
    end
    describe d do
      its('params.LoadState') { should eq 'not-found' }
    end
  end
end
